conclusions.rationale: Pin/Unpin menu entries, scope (current and following dictations until unpin or quit), pin mark and exact accessible name are observable.

conclusions.rationale: Current-only override, unpin restoring the captured route with source 'captured' (so pin_only sends no Enter) and pin activation independent of the 006 return setting are each testable.

conclusions.rationale: Unavailable pinned app: no insertion anywhere, transcript preserved per 006 with a named reason, pin retained, and resumption when the identity runs again.

conclusions.rationale: Single three-value setting, retained key, deterministic upgrade mapping (off->Never, on->Always) and removal of any other auto-submit control; SC-002 makes it measurable.

findings.description: Showing the pinned badge while 'Return to the dictation's application' is off would override feature 006 AC-003 (no badge when the setting is off); the 009 spec does not state this exception explicitly.
